key_insight: Primer is an open-source, LLM-agnostic framework that helps instructors create adaptive educational simulations grounded in their teaching goals and knowledge of students.
engineering_relevance: Its multi-agent architecture supports educator-guided simulation authoring and model choice, including local and open-source models for varied governance requirements.
method: Instructors provide subject knowledge, lesson goals, materials, and student context.
A multi-agent system carries instructional intent through simulation creation and delivery.
Generative AI produces responsive variations of student practice.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes the framework and release of prompts and a GitHub repository, but reports no quantitative evaluation or learning-outcome data.
watch_item: Faithfulness to instructional intent and educational effectiveness require validation before classroom deployment.
paper_title: Primer: An AI Framework for Instructor-Centered Educational Simulation Creation
